body:
Create your own custom plugins with skills! Build unique abilities, passives, and combo chains without touching Java. A clean GUI lets you wire events to actions, set cooldowns, mana costs, and permissions, then preview particle/sound effects in-game. Create class trees, level gates, and per-world rules; hook into Vault economy and placeholders; hot-reload changes; and export/share packs with one click. Works on modern Paper/Spigot servers and plays nicely with popular plugins.

Discord: https://discord.gg/777code
